name: Opening Day
summary: Let a dozen units on Quay Street and turn a daily profit.
briefing: The Quay Street lot has a foundation and $2.5M. The harbour board wants to see a working building before the season ends: at least twelve units let and a daily closing in the black by $5,000 or more.

name: Harbour Revival
summary: Bring 120 people back to the Saltmere waterfront on a tight budget.
briefing: Saltmere's harbour front has been empty for years. Land is cheap and building is cheap, but tenants are few and pay little. With $1.5M, house or employ 120 people and keep the building profitable for three days in a row.

name: Three Properties
summary: Grow from Quay Street into an estate of three properties.
briefing: Start with the Quay Street lot and build an estate: own three properties (Ferry Lane, Crown Yard or Harbour Row are for sale), house or employ 250 people and earn $10,000 a day across the estate.

name: Crown Prestige
summary: Raise a Class A address in Harrowgate with short elevator waits.
briefing: Harrowgate's tenants are demanding and building is dear. With $5M, raise Crown Yard to Class A, earn a reputation of 70 and keep the average elevator wait under 45 seconds.

name: Skyline
summary: 1,500 people, short waits, in profit — for a week.
briefing: The big one. Grow Quay Street into a tower of at least 1,500 residents and workers, keep the average elevator wait under a minute and stay profitable, all for seven days running.
